svg.text: EV Battery Module — Cell Holder Frame
1. Module houses 15 × 21700 Li-ion cells in 3×5 array.
2. Total heat load: 30 W at 2C discharge rate.
3. Cooling channels on both side walls (X± faces).
4. Wall thickness 3 mm standard; 7 mm at channel location.
5. All fillets R1.5 mm (inner corners) unless noted.
6. Surface finish Ra 1.6 μm on cell pocket walls.
